title: DecisionRecord
description: Canonical schema for agent multi-turn decision trajectories and calibrated confidence training records.

context_id.description: Unique deterministic identifier for the decision context (UUIDv7 or nanoid).

prompt.description: Input prompt or observation state presented to the agent model.

completion.description: Autoregressive generation or action emitted by the model.

evidence_list.description: List of cryptographic receipts, tool citations, or verified reference documents.

ground_truth_outcome.description: Empirical ground-truth verification outcome (e.g. success, failure, correct, incorrect).

risk_level.description: Operational risk level associated with this decision scope.

confidence.description: Predicted or calibrated confidence score strictly within [0.0, 1.0].

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp recording when the decision was executed.

calibrated_score.description: Post-hoc calibrated probability score strictly within [0.0, 1.0].

metadata.description: Auxiliary telemetry metadata and execution environment attributes.
